legal_name: Altruist (Altruist Financial LLC); being acquired by The Vanguard Group (agreement 26 Aug 2026, closing pending)
target_audience: Your target customers are independent financial advisors, from established advisory firms to teams breaking away from large brokerages, and leaders from that world are in Formula 1: UBS (Mercedes), Goldman Sachs (McLaren), Nuveen (Williams) and Carlyle (Red Bull). B2B brands are in the sport to host key clients, show their technology working under pressure and meet buyers worldwide. Teams also introduce partners to each other, to their owners and boards, and run joint activations at forums like Money20/20 and Web Summit.
market_overlap: You serve more than 6,000 advisors across the United States, and this autumn added AI financial planning in Hazel, pre-IPO investments and donor-advised funds to your platform. The Formula 1 calendar aligns with the markets you are present in and expanding into: Miami, Austin and Las Vegas.
market_reference: BNY, a competitor in custody and technology for wealth firms through Pershing, became the Atlassian Williams F1 Team's Official Institutional Banking Partner in January 2026. Its brand is on the FW48 and the team kit, and it uses the 24-race season to create client touchpoints and bring financial audiences together in the main financial hubs.
shared_values: A Formula 1 team runs every decision off one shared set of live data. Altruist puts custody, trading, billing and reporting on one platform, with its Hazel AI, so advisors spend less time on admin and more with clients.
